title: Searching the Future
outcome: Execute A* and audit supplied heuristic admissibility and cost.
prerequisites: The mapped chapter and its notation

input_fields.edges: Directed from/to identifiers with finite nonnegative cost.
input_fields.heuristic: Object mapping each node to a nonnegative estimated remaining cost.
input_fields.heuristic_cost: Nonnegative declared cost of one heuristic evaluation, separate from path cost.

equations.label: EQV9-01
explanations: Equation (9.1) gives the cost of the best route that is forced to pass through a particular vertex.
Add the cheapest way of getting to the vertex to the cheapest way of finishing from it.

equations.label: EQV9-02
explanations: Equation (9.2) is the computable stand-in for Equation (9.1), and it is what the search actually sorts on.
Add what the search has already spent reaching the vertex to what it guesses finishing will cost.

equations.label: EQV9-03
explanations: Equation (9.3) is the condition under which the search cannot be talked out of the best path.
Never guess that finishing will cost more than it actually will.

equations.label: EQV9-04
explanations: Equation (9.4) requires the estimate to be consistent with itself from one vertex to the next.
The true cost of getting from one vertex to another, plus the estimate at the second, must be at least the estimate at the first.
